description.en: Diet advancement (fluids day 1, soft day 3, normal day 7), symptom monitoring, decision-making about imaging or endoscopic re-look.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for poem postoperative care but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs poem postoperative care independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches poem postoperative care to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
